panes.title: WHO IT IS
lines: never named, and we do not guess. *what it does*, never who it is.

post.x: one address holds 5.48 percent of every kaspa in circulation, about 1.52B KAS. at the current emission rate the entire network needs 759 days to mine that much. it has never been named. we report what it does, never who it is.
post.reply: every move that wallet makes is on kaspapulse.com/entity-x.html. an address is not a person, one owner can hold many.
